races.paceDynamic: Frankies Fortune is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset, likely to be allowed an uncontested lead given the lack of other pace angles. With six hold-up horses and only Dunsy Rock showing prominent tendencies, the early gallop will be controlled and measured over this staying trip. The tactical setup creates a sustained rhythm rather than early pressure, allowing the leaders to conserve energy for the business end. This race shape heavily favours prominent runners and front runners who can utilize the soft early pace, while hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground against horses who haven't been softened up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Frankies Fortune gets an easy lead and stays galloping
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalizes on the lack of pace pressure to control the race from pillar to post, with soft fractions allowing maximum reserves for the finish. Prominent runners get first run at the leader while hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Dunsy Rock applies pressure to Frankies Fortune turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a battle between the two most forward runners, with their early engagement creating opportunities for strong finishers to pick up the pieces. The pace duel opens the door for hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is exceptionally slow and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The lack of early gallop allows hold-up horses to remain closer than usual, setting up a sprint finish where class and finishing speed decide the outcome. Celtic Alliance and Viscountess Nelson benefit from their proven turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a tactical affair
scenarios.body: The race develops into a messy, stop-start contest where any horse with tactical speed can steal a march, potentially suiting the lightly-raced Quinnfinity or an improver like Sagonige who has shown recent form uplift.

races.paceDynamic: Joeybottles is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset, likely to get an uncontested lead given the lack of other prominent racers. King Jon Oliver and Kingston Narcissus will track in second and third positions, but neither typically forces the pace early. With seven hold-up horses including A King Of Magic, La Vish, and Platin Moon needing room to maneuver late, this becomes a tactical waiting game behind a moderate gallop. This race shape strongly favors front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will befall the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Joeybottles Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Joeybottles maintains a steady but uncontested lead throughout.
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets perfect fractions with no pressure and kicks clear when the field closes, while hold-up horses struggle for racing room in the final furlong. This scenario rewards the leader and any prominent racers who stayed close.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If King Jon Oliver or Kingston Narcissus decide to challenge Joeybottles early in the race.
scenarios.body: The increased early pace sets up perfectly for the strong-finishing hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces late. A King Of Magic and La Vish benefit most from this pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent creates severe interference in the straight.
scenarios.body: Several fancied hold-up horses get blocked or hampered, allowing the leaders to maintain their advantage despite a slower pace. Those who secured clear runs early prosper.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Clear Run Champion
scenarios.trigger: If one hold-up horse gets a perfect passage through the field while others are stuck.
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, a top-class hold-up performer with the clearest run can still prevail in a driving finish. Requires exceptional jockeyship and timing.

races.paceDynamic: Timefortom will set a controlled gallop from the front without pressure, as he's the only confirmed front runner in this field. Stoner's Choice and Lets Mingle will track prominently but neither is aggressive enough to challenge for the lead early. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Letterston Lily, Heard That, Buy Some Time, Gentleman Bill, So Many Roads, Karton Plein, Soldier's Leap) will be content to settle and wait for their moment. This sets up a tactical affair with a sustainable pace that strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick over the final 2-3 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Timefortom sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate through halfway
scenarios.body: The large field of hold-up runners get the perfect setup with plenty of horse left for the closing stages, allowing the best finishers to sweep past a vulnerable leader. Multiple hold-up horses will arrive together in the final furlong with superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Stoner's Choice or Lets Mingle position perfectly in second and kick at the right moment
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners gets first run on the field while Timefortom weakens and before the hold-up horses fully wind up. Their tactical positioning gives them the edge in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Timefortom Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner's stamina proves superior and he can quicken again when challenged
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, Timefortom's class and fitness edge allows him to repel all challengers in the final 2 furlongs. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on ground that's riding slower than expected.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If something unexpected happens to Timefortom or he goes too slow through the early stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 6 furlongs out with no clear pace structure, turning into a muddling affair where the handiest horse on the day prevails. Fitness and jumping accuracy become the key factors.

races.paceDynamic: Classic Maestro and Toothless will both want the early lead, creating immediate pressure from the flag. King Roly sits just behind as the prominent runner, while the hold-up brigade of Tommy's Oscar, Whistleinthedark, Westerninthepark and Inox Allen will be looking for strong pace to close into. This contested early pace should create a genuine gallop that will favour the closers who can pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with neither leader committing fully
scenarios.body: King Roly and Slanagaibhgoleir are best placed to quicken when the tempo lifts in the straight. Their prominent/handy positions allow them to strike at the optimal moment.

scenarios.trigger: If both Classic Maestro and Toothless are pulled back early creating a crawl
scenarios.body: Any horse with a turn of foot can win from this messy scenario. The race becomes a lottery where position matters more than running style.

races.paceDynamic: Minella Drama and If Not For Dylan will contest the early lead in this 3m handicap chase, with both confirmed front-runners likely to establish a genuine gallop from the outset. Their pace rivalry should create an honest tempo that will test stamina reserves over the extended trip, particularly as both carry significant weight (170lbs and 145lbs respectively). The sustained early pace will set up the race for prominent runners who can track the leaders without being caught in the early battle, while hold-up horses like Statuario and Ned Tanner may find the genuine gallop plays to their strengths if the front pair weaken. This shape favours prominent trackers and strong-staying hold-up horses with the tactical speed to capitalize on a potentially depleted front rank.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front pair duel hard
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Drama and If Not For Dylan engage in a sustained speed battle from early
scenarios.body: Their weight-carrying effort over 3m will create significant back-stretch weakening, allowing prominent trackers to inherit the lead approaching the final obstacles. Mountain Mike and American Mike are ideally positioned to capitalize from their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses thrive
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves genuinely strong and sustainable throughout
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will perfectly suit Statuario's hold-up style, allowing him to unleash his proven finishing kick against tired front-runners. His excellent good going record (3W5P from 10 starts) makes him the primary beneficiary of this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Minella Drama stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Drama can dictate fractions without excessive pressure from If Not For Dylan
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old's class advantage (OR 142) and recent proximity to grade one level allows him to control the race tactically and resist late challengers. His experience at this trip gives him the edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners fail to engage or one drops out early due to jumping errors
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical positioning matters more than stamina, potentially suiting American Mike's class despite his inconsistent recent form. The reduced pace negates the trip specialists' advantages.

races.paceDynamic: Burgundy Man will lead from the start with his confirmed front-running style, likely setting a steady gallop over this 3m trip without immediate pressure. William Of York, Loulou Madrik, Jakana and Uptown Harry should track the leader in the prominent positions, creating a moderate pace through the early stages. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Lady In The Park, Casual Observer, Inis Oirr, Nights In Venice, Sir Carnegie and Jirko will look to launch late challenges. This tactical setup with one uncontested leader and multiple closers strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick clear before the hold-up brigade arrives.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Burgundy Man sets a steady gallop and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can time their challenges perfectly off the uncontested pace, getting first run on the field. William Of York or Loulou Madrik benefit most from this tactical position with enough stamina reserves to resist late challengers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Burgundy Man weakens significantly in the straight.
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get the perfect setup to unleash devastating finishing kicks on tired leaders. Lady In The Park's class edge or Casual Observer's recent form spike makes them dangerous late threats.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Burgundy Man gets soft fractions and the field allows him too much rope throughout.
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage with no serious pace pressure, making his 21-day break and good going form decisive. His recent consistent placings show he can handle this level when getting an easy lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage early or Burgundy Man goes too fast.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between whatever horses have energy left after pace machinations. The lightly-weighted runners like Nights In Venice or rejuvenated types like Sir Carnegie could steal it.

watchPoints.text: Burgundy Man getting uncontested lead with soft fractions will make him very hard to peg back.
William Of York's positioning behind the leader - if he tracks closely he becomes the tactical winner.
Lady In The Park's finishing kick from rear relies entirely on genuine pace being set up front.
Nights In Venice carrying just 148lbs could make significant difference in tight finish.
Multiple hold-up horses leaving runs simultaneously could cause traffic problems in straight.
